narr: A mid level trough and a quasi-stationary boundary across Southern New England led to widespread flash flooding in the late hours of the 3rd into the 4th. Most of the flooding was in Rhode Island and Connecticut where cars became stuck in water, and several basements were flooded. In MA a few roads were closed.
ev: In Cranston, Pleasant St was flooded and impassable.
In Providence, the intersection of Francis St and West Exchange St closed due to flooding.
In Providence, Jastram St was flooded with 5 cars stuck in floodwaters.
In Pawtucket, an entire basement level of an apartment complex was compromised due to flooding. American Red Cross requested to help displaced residents.
In North Providence, there was a social media report of 2.5 feet of water running over May St.
In Providence, the corner of Valley St and Atwells Ave was flooded and impassable.
In Providence, Pawtucket Ave was flooded.
In Lincoln, there were cars stuck in flood waters.
